short_blurb: From remodels to ground-up builds — your Pasadena general contractor.
local_note: Pasadena homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Pasadena's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Pasadena, including Bungalow Heaven, Old Pasadena, South Arroyo, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Pasadena?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Pasadena building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Pasadena?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Pasadena rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Pasadena remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
